# Data Source: tfe_variables

Gets all variables defined in a workspace or variable set.

-> **Note:** One of `WorkspaceId` or `VariableSetId` is required.

## Example Usage

```go
import constructs "github.com/aws/constructs-go/constructs"
import "github.com/hashicorp/terraform-cdk-go/cdktf"
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/dataTfeVariableSet"
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/dataTfeVariables"
type myConvertedCode struct {
	TerraformStack
}

func newMyConvertedCode(scope Construct, name *string) *myConvertedCode {
	this := &myConvertedCode{}
	cdktf.NewTerraformStack_Override(this, scope, name)
	dataTfeVariableSetTest :=
	dataTfeVariableSet.NewDataTfeVariableSet(this, jsii.String("test"), &DataTfeVariableSetConfig{
		name: jsii.String("my-variable-set-name"),
		organization: jsii.String("my-org-name"),
	})
	dataTfeVariablesTest := dataTfeVariables.NewDataTfeVariables(this, jsii.String("test_1"), &DataTfeVariablesConfig{
		variableSetId: cdktf.Token_AsString(dataTfeVariableSetTest.id),
	})
	/*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
	dataTfeVariablesTest.OverrideLogicalId(jsii.String("test"))
	return this
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `VariableSetId` (String) ID of the variable set.
- `WorkspaceId` (String) ID of the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `Env` (Attributes List) List containing environment variables configured on the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `Id` (String) Static identifier for the variables group in the workspace.
- `Terraform` (Attributes List) List containing terraform variables configured on the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--terraform))
- `Variables` (Attributes List) List containing terraform and environment variables configured on the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))

<a id="nestedatt--env"></a>
### Nested Schema for `Env`

Read-Only:

- `Category` (String) The category of the variable. Valid values are `Terraform` or `Env`.
- `Hcl` (Boolean) Whether the variable is marked as HCL or not.
- `Id` (String) The variable ID.
- `Name` (String) The variable Key name.
- `Sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the variable's value is sensitive and hidden.
- `Value` (String) The variable value. If the variable is sensitive this value will be empty.


<a id="nestedatt--terraform"></a>

Read-Only:
